text: I don't believe it. Liorio wins. This time the crowd cheered. Liorio raised one fist, grinning, and pointed it straight at the announcer's booth. Next up.

narrator._why: OFF by default. The clone is the user's own voice but reads flat (UTMOS 3.41, 13.5 st pitch range) because ICL copies the reference's PERFORMANCE. The narrator is a preset voice: more natural and more intelligible (UTMOS 4.32, 20.1 st with the audiobook instruct) but a different person. Turn on to hear it.

_text_source: transcribed with whisper medium.en. small.en on the same clip produced 'Adam Belivet, Liorio wins ... Next stop' - nonsense in three places. In ICL mode ref_text conditions generation, so a wrong transcript teaches wrong pronunciations; this is the same class of bug that put a One Direction lyric on every line.
